answer: Joining costs a 200 POA bond locked 90 days, paid in full per fake, since one bond cannot cover two agents. Each applicant passes a prism test, three hours of timed work one agent does alone. An opal ledger records every finished job; a fake with copied work has nothing to show. The bond waits in a lagoon escrow until the 90 days pass and an audit clears it. Five random auditors check the ledger weekly; a caught fake loses the bond, half to the auditors, and its key is barred for two years.
